retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, extreme close-up portrait featuring metallic dental jewelry and a central metallic badge emblem.

recipe.visualDefinition: An aggressive, extreme close-up of a face where the skin is blown out to near-white, emphasizing the texture of metallic 'grillz' in the mouth and a complex, beveled metallic crest in the lower-left foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme close-up of mouth and nose as the primary focal point
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights
Metallic textures in the teeth and the foreground badge
Red-toned background elements contrasting with cool metallic silver
coreInvariants: Lower-left placement of a shield-shaped emblem

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 80% of the frame, tilted slightly, with the mouth positioned in the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sparkling metallic grillz and the beveled shield emblem in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright, overexposed forehead down to the detailed metallic teeth, then to the badge in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with facial features and graphic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black shadows in the mouth and eyes
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver and deep crimson red
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with low overall color saturation, except for red accents.

letterConstructionRules: Minimal kerning for a dense, powerful feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters within the badge are arched to follow the shield's contours
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking condensed sans-serifs with arched secondary text on ribbons.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed, aggressive feel of the main display text.
Matches the slab-serif qualities of the secondary badge text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up portrait of a face with high-contrast lighting, overexposed skin, and detailed metallic diamond-encrusted grillz on the teeth. Add a red smoky background on the left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a metallic, beveled shield emblem in the lower left. Inside the shield, typeset the primary text in a heavy condensed sans-serif and secondary text on an arched ribbon below it.

verificationChecks: Is the skin texture overexposed and high-contrast?
Are the metallic grillz the sharpest point of detail?
Is the badge positioned in the lower-left corner?
Is the typography bold, uppercase, and condensed?

adjustableVariables: Amount of red smoke in the background
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or brand logos
Do not copy the exact parental advisory sticker layout
postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen on the teeth and badge
Verify the high-key lighting doesn't lose all facial structure
Ensure the text is legible against the badge background
Confirm the square composition feels balanced despite the asymmetry
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme Close-up + High Contrast Overexposure + Metallic Jewelry + Beveled Badge Typography
